title: Pre lit 6ft natural looking garland
text: Pre lit 6ft natural looking garland. This a lovely, faux garland.  It is very natural looking, but is faux.  It bends nicely to fit.  The colors are lovely with sprinkling of red berries.  There are 20 LED lights with a timer box.  Takes 3 AA batteries.  The timer is 6 hours on, 18 off.  Not sure how long the batteries will last.. the previous garland I had lasted about 2 weeks on 3 batteries.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. All of my reviews reflect my honest, personal experience with the reviewed item - your experience may be different. I am not influenced by any outside source. I receive/accept NO free products or discounts that are not available to all shoppers- ever. product_metadata.title: Valery Madelyn Pre-Lit 6 Feet Natural Fresh Red Green Christmas Garland with 20 LED Lights and Berries for Front Door Window Fireplace Mantle Xmas Decor, Battery Operated
features: 【Original Design】Valery Madelyn is a retail brand with original design. The city's feasting and feasting makes us exhausted, returning home to enjoy the tranquility of nature. The theme of the natural fresh allows you to let go of a year's fatigue and return to the nature. Imagine walking on the field path, embrace the fresh air of nature and enjoy the holiday

【Very Full & Long Enough】- This 6ft Christmas garland is full of pine cones, red berries, artificial eucalypti leaves, fern leaves, pine needles and other rich elements, creating true colors and natural scene in winter, delivering holiday sentiments with accents of peace and serenity and bringing holiday cheer to your family. Matching with our matching wreath is perfect yet easy way

This door garland will sustain its original colors and lifelike appearance for years. Note: For better display, please extend the garland when you take them out of the box
【Battery Operated LED Light】 - This lighted garland is 6 hours on, 18 hours off, auto-cycle daily, dimmable with 8 light effects. 3 AA batteries required (not included)
